title: One-dimensional automaton step
prompt: The list is a row of cells (true = alive). Return the row after one step of this rule, applied to every cell at once: a cell is alive in the next step if and only if exactly one of its two neighbours (the cells immediately to its left and right) is alive now; the cell's own state does not matter. Cells outside the row count as dead. The result has the same length as the input; the empty row stays empty.
